label: Published AirDrive firmware
whatsNew: New version highlights: OTA firmware updates and firmware checks. Updated game names to reduce any legal/trademark conflicts. Improved AirDrive wake-up process, so less chance of Disk not ready errors during menu loads. The address shown while TS-DOS loads is portacoco.com/airdrive.html. Highly recommend you do this update.
note: Application only. Does not include the five virtual disks.
